blocks.text: PUERTO PRINCESA CITY, Palawan — Police seized P150,000 worth of smuggled cigarettes in an operation on Rampano Road, Purok Sampalok, Barangay Sicsican, here at around 1:20 a.m. on Wednesday. The operation conducted by joint personnel of Police Station 2 under the Puerto Princesa City Police Office (PPCPO) and City Mobile Force Company (CMFC) also led to the arrest of a 30-year-old male resident of Zone II, Barangay Sicsican. Confiscated during the operation were 10 boxes of suspected smuggled cigarettes, P30,000 marked money used in the buy-bust, and a Toyota Vios Super Red V car.
